notes: Follows rule 26's own division of מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם → From this time forth and for evermore: 'and' to the waw, 'for' to עַד, 'evermore' to עוֹלָם.
Both לְ after סָבִיב are unrepresented per rule 40's own example; 'round about' stays whole with סָבִיב. Written name takes 'Jerusalem'; resumptive suffix is the unrendered occurrence (rule 22).
